"""The checkpoint orchestrator accepts only exact retained local wire journals."""

import json
import runpy
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.epoch import fingerprint
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.residual import _request_id


def load_transport(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl_api_checkpoint.py"
    module = runpy.run_path(str(path))
    transport = module["RetainedTransport"]
    globals_ = transport.__init__.__globals__
    questions, answers = tmp_path / "questions.json", tmp_path / "answers.json"
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals_, "NOTES", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals_, "QUESTIONS", questions)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals_, "ANSWERS", answers)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals_, "PRIME_QUESTIONS", tmp_path / "prime-questions.json")
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals_, "PRIME_ANSWERS", tmp_path / "prime-answers.json")
    payload = {"entry_id": "synthetic:retained", "bank": "I", "allowed_values": [-1, 0, 1]}
    schema = {"properties": {"I": {"enum": [-1, 0, 1, None]}}}
    identity = _request_id(payload)
    questions.write_text(json.dumps({"questions": [{"request_id": identity, "request": payload, "schema": schema}]}))
    (tmp_path / "ssl-v2-catalogue-rebase.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "question_reuse": {
                    "transport": "synthetic:pinned-local",
                    "journal_directory": str(tmp_path),
                    "original_request_id": identity,
                }
            }
        )
    )
    (tmp_path / ("teach-" + identity + ".intent.json")).write_text(
        json.dumps({"request_id": identity, "schema": schema, "transport": "synthetic:pinned-local"})
    )
    (tmp_path / ("teach-" + identity + ".result.json")).write_text(json.dumps({"raw_output": '{"I":0}'}))
    return transport, questions, answers, payload, schema


def test_retained_transport_never_calls_a_model_and_refuses_changed_question(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    cls, _, _, payload, schema = load_transport(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    model = cls()
    assert model(payload, schema) == '{"I":0}'
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_QUESTION_CHANGED"):
        model({**payload, "bank": "YOU"}, schema)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_QUESTION_CHANGED"):
        model(payload, {})
    assert len(model.replayed) == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("damage", ["packet", "model", "reply"])
def test_supplied_answer_cannot_rebind_the_original_evidence(tmp_path, monkeypatch, damage):
    cls, questions, answers, payload, _ = load_transport(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    answer = {
        "format": "GSE.ssl-checkpoint-local-answers/1",
        "questions_sha256": fingerprint(questions),
        "transport": "synthetic:pinned-local",
        "answers": [{"request_id": _request_id(payload), "raw_output": '{"I":0}'}],
    }
    if damage == "packet":
        answer["questions_sha256"] = "0" * 64
    elif damage == "model":
        answer["transport"] = "synthetic:other"
    else:
        answer["answers"][0]["raw_output"] = '{"I":1}'
    answers.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError, match="CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_ANSWERS_IDENTITY_CHANGED|CHECKPOINT_ORIGINAL_REPLY_CHANGED"
    ):
        cls()


def test_prime_reply_requires_exact_wire_packet_and_retains_null(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    cls, _, _, _, _ = load_transport(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    globals_ = cls.__init__.__globals__
    payload = {"entry_id": "synthetic:prime", "bank": "GOOD"}
    schema = {"properties": {"GOOD": {"enum": [-1, 0, 1, None]}}}
    identity = _request_id(payload)
    packet = globals_["PRIME_QUESTIONS"]
    packet.write_text(json.dumps({"questions": [{"request_id": identity, "request": payload, "schema": schema}]}))
    answer = {
        "format": "GSE.ssl-checkpoint-local-answers/1",
        "questions_sha256": fingerprint(packet),
        "transport": "synthetic:pinned-local",
        "answers": [{"request_id": identity, "raw_output": '{"GOOD":null}'}],
    }
    globals_["PRIME_ANSWERS"].write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    model = cls()
    assert model(payload, schema) == '{"GOOD":null}'
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_QUESTION_CHANGED"):
        model(payload, {})
    answer["transport"] = "other"
    globals_["PRIME_ANSWERS"].write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="CHECKPOINT_PRIME_ANSWERS_IDENTITY_CHANGED"):
        model(payload, schema)

def test_canonical_chart_projection_is_partial_and_identity_scoped(key, bank, value):
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.catalog import chart_definition_records
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.engine import propagate
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.foundation import BANKS

    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl_api_checkpoint.py"
    module = runpy.run_path(str(path))
    entry = "nsm_chart:v20:" + key
    features = next(row for row in chart_definition_records() if row["entry_id"] == entry)
    observation = {
        "entry_id": entry,
        "candidate_entry_ids": [entry],
        "source": "nsm_chart",
        "family": "nsm_primary_chart",
        "scope": "source_structure",
        "features": features,
    }
    assertion = module["basis_assertion"](entry, bank, value, observation)
    result = propagate(BANKS, (assertion,), ())

def test_reserved_child_is_reexported_without_unselected_parent_definitions(monkeypatch):
    from copy import deepcopy

    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl_api_checkpoint.py"
    module = runpy.run_path(str(path))
    parent = {
        "format": "synthetic:input",
        "discovery_entry_ids": ["water"],
        "audit_entry_ids": ["dog", "door", "tree"],
        "rulings": [{"receipt": {"request_id": "water-question"}, "review": {"source_refs": ["native"]}}],
        "entries": [{"definition": {"entry_id": key}} for key in ("dog", "door", "tree", "water")],
        "guarded_candidates": [{"warrant": {"statement": "reference only"}}],
    }
    unchanged = deepcopy(parent)
    calls = []

    def exporter(database, selection, *, input_format):
        calls.append((database, selection, input_format))
        child = deepcopy(parent)
        child["audit_entry_ids"] = selection["audit_entry_ids"]
        child["guarded_candidates"] = selection["guarded_candidates"]
        selected = set(selection["discovery_entry_ids"]) | set(selection["audit_entry_ids"])
        child["entries"] = [row for row in child["entries"] if row["definition"]["entry_id"] in selected]
        return {"input": child, "input_sha256": _request_id(child)}

    fn = module["reserved_reviewed_input"]
    monkeypatch.setitem(fn.__globals__, "export_reviewed_input", exporter)
    child = fn("owned.db", parent, {"dog"})
    assert parent == unchanged
    assert child["audit_entry_ids"] == ["door", "tree"]
    assert {row["definition"]["entry_id"] for row in child["entries"]} == {"water", "door", "tree"}
    assert child["guarded_candidates"][0]["warrant"]["required_reservation_ids"] == ["dog"]
    assert len(calls) == 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="CHECKPOINT_RESERVATION_NOT_IN_PARENT_AUDIT"):
        fn("owned.db", parent, {"cat"})

"""Exercise durable, bounded post-build completion through real stored artifacts."""

import json
import sqlite3
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict

import pytest

from GSE.curation.cli import commands
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.completion import complete_dictionary
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.engine import DomainRestriction, Relation
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.evidence import Definition, EvidenceBundle, Observation
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.foundation import BANKS
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.pipeline import build_dictionary
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.validation import validate_build


class Transport:
    model = "fixture-model"

    def __init__(self, answer=None):
        self.answer = answer
        self.requests = []

    def __call__(self, payload, schema):
        self.requests.append((payload, schema))
        if callable(self.answer):
            return self.answer(payload, schema)
        return self.answer if self.answer is not None else json.dumps({payload["bank"]: payload["allowed_values"][-1]})


class VersionedTransport(Transport):
    def __init__(self, identity, answer=None):
        super().__init__(answer)
        self.identity = identity


def fixture_bundle(specs):
    """Explicit synthetic restrictions are fixture data, never a production zero rule."""
    definitions, observations, restrictions = [], [], []
    for entry_id, unknown in specs.items():
        definitions.append(Definition(entry_id, entry_id, "verb", "synthetic test definition"))
        record_id = f"record:{entry_id}"
        observations.append(Observation(entry_id, "fixture", record_id, "fixture", {}, "lexical"))
        for bank in BANKS:
            values = unknown.get(bank, (0,))
            if len(values) < 3:
                restrictions.append(DomainRestriction(bank, values, "fixture", record_id, "fixture"))
    return EvidenceBundle(tuple(definitions), tuple(observations), (), (), tuple(restrictions))


def built(tmp_path, specs=None, manifest=None):
    path = tmp_path / "dictionary.db"
    bundle = fixture_bundle(specs or {"d": {"GOOD": (-1, 1)}})
    build_dictionary(bundle, path, manifest=manifest)
    return path, bundle


def metadata(path, key):
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
        return json.loads(conn.execute("SELECT value FROM builder_metadata WHERE key=?", (key,)).fetchone()[0])


def state(path, entry="d"):
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
        return conn.execute(
            "SELECT code,domains,trace,hierarchy FROM definition_states WHERE entry_id=?", (entry,)
        ).fetchone()


def test_acceptance_mutates_file_atomically_and_replays(tmp_path):
    path, _ = built(tmp_path)
    before = state(path)
    transport = Transport()
    report = complete_dictionary(path, transport, 1, banks=("GOOD",))
    assert report["code"] == "SELECTED_SCOPE_RESOLVED"
    assert report["model_calls"] == 1
    assert report["dictionary_outcomes"] == {"RESOLVED": 1}
    assert report["dictionary_status"] == "ALL_BANKS_ASSIGNED"
    assert report["outside_selected_scope"] == {"unresolved_or_conflicted_cells": 0}
    assert metadata(path, "last_completion_report") == report
    assert metadata(path, "last_report")["model_calls"] == 1
    assert state(path) != before
    assert validate_build(path)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"
    payload, schema = transport.requests[0]
    assert payload["allowed_values"] == [-1, 1]
    assert schema["properties"]["GOOD"]["enum"] == [-1, 1, None]
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
        assert conn.execute("SELECT value FROM primitive_values WHERE primitive='GOOD'").fetchone()[0] == 1
        assert conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM builder_domain_restrictions").fetchone()[0] == len(BANKS)
        assert conn.execute("SELECT code FROM completion_attempts").fetchone()[0] == "ASSIGNED"
    again = complete_dictionary(
        path, Transport(lambda *_: pytest.fail("assigned cell reasked")), 1, entry_ids=("d",), banks=("GOOD",)
    )
    assert again["model_calls"] == 0
    assert again["code"] == "SELECTED_SCOPE_RESOLVED"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "answer,code",
    [
        ('{"GOOD":null}', "ABSTAINED"),
        ('{"GOOD":0}', "INVALID_OUTPUT"),
        ('{"GOOD":true}', "INVALID_OUTPUT"),
        ('{"GOOD":1,"WANT":1}', "INVALID_OUTPUT"),
        ("not json", "INVALID_OUTPUT"),
    ],
)
def test_rejected_or_abstained_output_keeps_original_dictionary(tmp_path, answer, code):
    path, _ = built(tmp_path)
    before = state(path)
    report = complete_dictionary(path, Transport(answer), 1, banks=("GOOD",))
    assert report["outcomes"] == {code: 1}
    assert report["code"] == "BUDGET_EXHAUSTED"
    assert state(path) == before
    assert metadata(path, "model_completions") == []
    assert validate_build(path)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"
    resumed = complete_dictionary(
        path, Transport(lambda *_: pytest.fail("unchanged attempt repeated")), 1, banks=("GOOD",)
    )
    assert resumed["code"] == "RESIDUAL_REMAINS"
    assert resumed["skipped_attempts"] == {code: 1}
    assert resumed["model_calls"] == 0


def test_interruption_journal_is_durable_and_retry_is_explicit(tmp_path):
    path, _ = built(tmp_path)

    def interrupted(*_):
        with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
            assert conn.execute("SELECT code FROM completion_attempts").fetchone()[0] == "RUNNING"
        raise KeyboardInterrupt()

    with pytest.raises(KeyboardInterrupt):
        complete_dictionary(path, Transport(interrupted), 1, entry_ids=("d",), banks=("GOOD",))
    assert metadata(path, "last_report")["model_calls"] == 1
    assert validate_build(path)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"
    resumed = complete_dictionary(
        path, Transport(lambda *_: pytest.fail("interrupted call repeated")), 1, entry_ids=("d",), banks=("GOOD",)
    )
    assert resumed["model_calls"] == 0
    assert resumed["skipped_attempts"] == {"RUNNING": 1}
    assert resumed["code"] == "RESIDUAL_REMAINS"
    retried = complete_dictionary(path, Transport(), 1, entry_ids=("d",), banks=("GOOD",), retry=True)
    assert retried["outcomes"] == {"ASSIGNED": 1}
    assert metadata(path, "last_report")["model_calls"] == 2
    assert validate_build(path)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"


def test_changed_source_context_is_a_new_request_even_when_domains_match(tmp_path):

        record["features"]["new_native_context"] = "fixture clarification"
        conn.execute("UPDATE source_observations SET payload=?", (json.dumps(record),))

    report = complete_dictionary(path, Transport(), 1, banks=("GOOD",))

def test_new_transport_protocol_identity_is_not_skipped(tmp_path):
    path, _ = built(tmp_path)
    first = VersionedTransport("fixture-model@protocol-one", '{"GOOD":null}')
    complete_dictionary(path, first, 1, banks=("GOOD",))
    second = VersionedTransport("fixture-model@protocol-two")
    report = complete_dictionary(path, second, 1, banks=("GOOD",))
    assert report["model_calls"] == 1
    assert report["model"] == second.identity
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
        assert {row[0] for row in conn.execute("SELECT model FROM completion_attempts")} == {
            first.identity,
            second.identity,
        }
    assert validate_build(path)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"


def test_no_eligible_entries_does_not_claim_conflicted_dictionary_resolved(tmp_path):
    path, initial = built(tmp_path)
    conflict = DomainRestriction("GOOD", (0,), "fixture", "record:d", "fixture")

def test_transport_error_stays_distinct_and_does_not_overwrite(tmp_path):

def test_global_and_per_entry_limits_and_priority(tmp_path):
    path, _ = built(
        tmp_path,
        {"wide": {"GOOD": (-1, 0, 1)}, "narrow": {"GOOD": (-1, 1), "WANT": (-1, 0, 1)}, "single": {"GOOD": (-1, 1)}},

def test_conditional_contradiction_does_not_replace_hard_values(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from functools import partial

    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.engine import propagate

    # The all-negative assignment satisfies this cycle. A seven-combination
    # search limit leaves the unsupported positive choice for the residual tail.
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.resolution.propagate", partial(propagate, max_joint_assignments=7)
    )
    names = ("GOOD", "WANT", "THINK")
    relations = [
        Relation(
            f"cycle:{i}",
            (names[i], names[(i + 1) % 3]),
            ((-1, -1), (1, 1)) if i < 2 else ((-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1)),
            ("synthetic satisfiable cycle",),
            approved=True,
        )
        for i in range(3)
    ]
    manifest = tmp_path / "rules.json"
    manifest.write_text(json.dumps({"format": "GSE.lexicon-rules/1", "relations": [asdict(r) for r in relations]}))
    path, _ = built(tmp_path, {"d": {bank: (-1, 1) for bank in names}}, manifest)
    before = state(path)
    assert any(record["kind"] == "SOLVER_LIMIT" for record in json.loads(before[2]))
    assert propagate(names, (), tuple(relations)).assignments == dict.fromkeys(names, -1)
    report = complete_dictionary(path, Transport(), 1, banks=("GOOD",))
    assert report["outcomes"] == {"CONTRADICTION": 1}
    assert state(path) == before
    assert validate_build(path)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"

class Transport:
    identity = "synthetic-rule-migration-test"

    def __init__(self, value=1):
        self.value = value

    def __call__(self, payload, schema):
        return json.dumps({payload["bank"]: self.value})


def packet(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "source.db"
    definitions = tuple(
        Definition(x, x, "noun" if x == "b" else "verb", "synthetic test definition") for x in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "h")
    )
    observations = tuple(
        Observation(d.entry_id, "wordnet_hierarchy", d.entry_id, "taxonomy", {}, "lexical") for d in definitions
    )
    native = (Assertion("ALIVE", 0, "wordnet_hierarchy", "a", "taxonomy"),)
    build_dictionary(EvidenceBundle(definitions, observations, native, ()), path)
    for entry, bank, value in (("a", "WANT", -1), ("a", "BE", 0), ("b", "WANT", 0), ("d", "WANT", 1)):
        report = complete_dictionary(path, Transport(value), 1, entry_ids=(entry,), banks=(bank,))
        assert report["outcomes"] == {"ASSIGNED": 1}
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
        receipt = read_model_receipts(conn)["d"][0]
    selection = {
        "format": "GSE.reviewed-pattern-selection/1",
        "discovery_entry_ids": ["d"],
        "audit_entry_ids": ["h"],
        "reviews": [
            {
                "request_id": receipt["request_id"],
                "review": {
                    "review_id": "synthetic-review",
                    "reviewer": "test-fixture",
                    "code": "ACCEPTED",
                    "receipt_sha256": _request_id(receipt),
                    "source_refs": ["synthetic:test-only"],
                    "rationale": "Fixture authority, not linguistic gold.",
                },
            }
        ],
        "guarded_candidates": [
            {
                "antecedent": None,
                "consequent": ["WANT", 1],
                "guards": [["pos", "verb"]],
                "absent_evidence": [],
                "warrant": {
                    "warrant_id": "synthetic-law",

                    "reviewer": "test-fixture",
                },
            }
        ],
    }
    exported = export_reviewed_input(path, selection)
    input_path, audit_path = tmp_path / "input.json", tmp_path / "audit.json"

        "decision": "APPROVE_DEFINITIONAL_RULE",
        "rationale": "Synthetic migration fixture, not a real word rule.",
        "source_refs": ["synthetic:test-only"],
    }
    return path, input_path, audit_path, review


def entries(path):
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
        return {row["entry_id"]: row for row in read_entries(conn)}


def test_real_cli_migration_archives_affected_chain_preserves_unaffected_and_unknown(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    path, input_path, audit_path, review = packet(tmp_path)
    output, report_path, review_path = (tmp_path / name for name in ("migrated.db", "report.json", "review.json"))
    review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review))
    before = path.read_bytes()
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "sys.argv",
        [
            "migrate",
            "--candidate",
            str(path),
            "--output",
            str(output),
            "--input",
            str(input_path),
            "--audit",
            str(audit_path),
            "--review",
            str(review_path),
            "--report",
            str(report_path),
        ],
    )
    assert main() == 0
    result = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
    assert result["archived_model_receipts"] == 3
    assert result["retained_model_receipts"] == 1
    assert result["postflight"]["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"
    assert result["active_pointer_changed"] is False
    assert path.read_bytes() == before
    states = entries(output)
    assert states["a"]["assignments"]["WANT"] == 1
    assert states["a"]["assignments"]["ALIVE"] == 0
    assert states["a"]["domains"]["BE"] == [-1, 0, 1]
    assert states["a"]["domains"]["FEEL"] == [-1, 0, 1]
    assert states["b"]["assignments"]["WANT"] == 0
    with sqlite3.connect(output) as conn:
        assert set(read_model_receipts(conn)) == {"b"}
        event = json.loads(conn.execute("SELECT payload FROM rule_migrations").fetchone()[0])
        assert [a["assertion"]["bank"] for a in event["archived"][0]["receipts"]] == ["WANT", "BE"]
        for table in ("rule_versions", "model_rule_versions", "rule_migrations"):
            with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match="APPEND_ONLY"):
                conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table}")
    assert validate_build(output)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"
    complete_dictionary(output, Transport(0), 1, entry_ids=("a",), banks=("BE",))
    assert validate_build(output)["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"

def test_corpus_counterexample_refuses_entire_migration(tmp_path):
    path, input_path, audit_path, review = packet(tmp_path)
    # New hard source evidence outside discovery/audit defeats the synthetic law.
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as conn:
        from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.completion import _entry
        from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.foundation import BANKS, definition_context
        from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.resolution import resolve_dictionary
        from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.storage import store_entry
        from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.validation import _metadata, _relations

        definition, assertions, restrictions, hierarchy = _entry(conn, "c")
        assertions = assertions + (Assertion("WANT", -1, "wordnet_hierarchy", "c", "taxonomy"),)
        resolved = resolve_dictionary(
            BANKS,
            assertions,
            _relations(_metadata(conn, "relations")),
            definition_context("verb"),
            evidence_banks=BANKS,
        )
        store_entry(conn, definition, resolved, assertions, hierarchy, domain_restrictions=restrictions)
    preflight = validate_build(path)
    assert preflight["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED", preflight["mismatches"]
    output = tmp_path / "failed.db"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="SCOPE_COUNTEREXAMPLE"):
        migrate_rule(path, output, input_path, audit_path, review)
    assert not output.exists()
    assert not list(tmp_path.glob(".gse-migration-*"))

UNIT rule_changes 
def rule_changes(before, after):
    """Approved relations whose applicability or consequence may have changed."""
    old = {rule.rule_id: rule for rule in before}
    new = {rule.rule_id: rule for rule in after}
    return (
        tuple(rule for rule in before if rule.approved and new.get(rule.rule_id) != rule),
        tuple(rule for rule in after if rule.approved and old.get(rule.rule_id) != rule),
    )

def touches_scope(relations, context):
    return any(all(context.get(key) == value for key, value in rule.guards) for rule in relations)
